A broad-bodied atmospheric craft with articulated bird-like wings. Unit-scale inner and outer hinge groups provide a clean two-stage flap without inherited-scale distortion.

A rugged short-range strike fighter built around twin oversized drives, a heavily armoured wedge fuselage and long wingtip cannon mounts. The Razorfin trades elegance for survivability, acceleration and an unmistakably aggressive silhouette.

A compact pressure-stable modular cargo container with reinforced corner latches, magnetic handling clamps, a shock-isolated outer frame and a short-range inventory transponder. Its 3.2 metre shell is sized for light and medium craft recovery work.
